newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bosphorus strait reopened to some small ships.
newsitem.headline: Bosphorus strait reopened to some small ships.

text.p: The narrow Bosphorus strait was intermittently reopened to small passenger vessels accompanied by pilots late on Thursday after it was closed completely due to fog, maritime officials said.
"From time to time we allow small boats into the straits, both northbound and southbound, as long as they are accompanied by pilots," one official said.
The strait had been closed since late on Wednesday. The official said around 100 ships were waiting to enter the strait.
Visibility fluctuated between half a mile and one mile, the official said
